composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Runs first. When the 'Idempotency-Key' header repeats a key already seen, short-circuit with a
# 200 replay of the originally created owner (before the duplicate check below would 409); otherwise
# publish the key for RecordIdempotency and continue building.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Assign the deterministic householdId (SHA-256 over lastName + postcode). It no longer drives
# duplicate detection; it is retained for household-size and membership derivations. Owners at the
# same last name and postcode are the same household.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureUniqueIdentity

# The single duplicate block: reject a second owner whose identityKey (SHA-256 over normalized
# telephone + lower-case email + soundex of the last name) matches an existing one with 409, unless
# the request set 'sharesHousehold' to declare it a household member.
ensureUniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyOwnerLimit

ensureDailyOwnerLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

# Soft match: flag an owner whose identityKey differs from an existing one but whose soundex(lastName)
# and postcode match. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold') is never flagged.
assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Owner is now persisted (id assigned); remember it against the Idempotency-Key (if any) so a repeat
# replays this owner. No-op when the request carried no key.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotency
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: notify

# Owner is persisted with its memberId assigned; enqueue a welcome notification carrying the owner
# id and the memberId to the dedicated NOTIFY logger.
notify:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnqueueWelcomeNotification
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints

Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.

- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.
- Transactions: `govern: [ transaction ]` on steps, not `@Transactional`.
- Errors: a handler YAML in `officefloor/escalation/`, not `@ControllerAdvice`.

I have thoroughly explored the repository. Here are my findings.

## Summary

This is a Spring PetClinic REST app converted to **OfficeFloor function injection** (endpoints defined as YAML pipelines of small Java function classes, not `@RestController`s). The `riskFlag` feature is **referenced by an acceptance test but not yet implemented** — it does not exist in the `Owner` entity, the `OwnerMapper`, the OpenAPI spec, or the generated `OwnerDto`. The supporting rules it aggregates (possible-duplicate, disposable email, city soft-capacity) *do* already exist. This looks like a feature to be implemented.

## 1. riskFlag references (only two, both in the test)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`
```java
6  /** risk-flag: Return 'riskFlag' true when any of these hold: the owner is a possible duplicate, the emai... */
7  class AcceptanceTest extends AcceptanceBase {
9      @Test
10     void coreRiskFlagFalseNormally() throws Exception {
11         int id = createOwnerOk(structuredOwner());
12         getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.riskFlag").value(false));
13     }
14 }
```
Note: the Javadoc spec on line 6 is **truncated in the source file itself** (ends with `the emai...`). The full rule text is not present anywhere in the repo. A grep for `riskFlag` across the entire tree returns only these two lines — there is no `riskFlag` property in `Owner`, the mapper, `openapi.yml`, or any generated DTO. `riskFlag` must be added as a derived, read-only response field.

## 2. The rules riskFlag aggregates (already implemented)

**Possible-duplicate (soft match):** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignPossibleDuplicate.java` — sets `owner.setPossibleDuplicate(true/false)` and `possibleDuplicateOf`. Matches when identityKey differs but Soundex(lastName)+postcode match; `sharesHousehold` requests never flagged.

**Disposable email domain:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerEmails.java`
```java
20  private static final Set<String> DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS = Set.of(
21          "mailinator.com", "tempmail.com", "guerrillamail.com");
...
42  if (DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS.contains(domain)) {
43      throw new InvalidEmailException("Email must not use a disposable-email domain");
```
Note: currently a disposable domain is *rejected* at build time (400 via `InvalidEmailException`), not merely flagged. Called from `BuildOwner.java:63`.

**City soft capacity (warning) — this is the "soft capacity" concept:** in the mapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
```java
35  private static final int CITY_CAPACITY_LIMIT = 50;
41  private static final int CITY_CAPACITY_WARNING_THRESHOLD = 40;
...
217 protected boolean capacityWarning(Owner owner) {   // true when city holds 40..49 owners
```
The **hard** city cap (409) is `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EnsureCityCapacity.java` (`MAX_OWNERS_PER_CITY = 50`, throws `CityAtCapacityException`).

**Hard duplicate / identity:** `EnsureUniqueIdentity.java` + `OwnerIdentity.java` (SHA-256 identityKey → 409 `DuplicateIdentityException`).

## 3. DTOs, response objects, entities

- Entity: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — has `possibleDuplicate` (L82-83), `possibleDuplicateOf` (L85-86), `namesakeCount`, `city` (L51-53), `email` (L61-62), `deleted`. **No `riskFlag` field.**
- Mapper: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — this is where all derived response fields are wired via `@Mapping(target=..., expression="java(...)")` on `toOwnerDto` (L46-66). A `riskFlag` mapping would be added here, alongside `capacityWarning`, `bulkSignupWarning`, etc.
- DTO: `OwnerDto` is **generated at build time** from `openapi.yml` (openapi-generator, `modelNameSuffix=Dto`, package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`). No checked-in source; no `target/` generated file currently exists. Request DTO is `OwnerFieldsDto`.
- OpenAPI spec: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — the `Owner` schema properties run from ~L2100 to L2365. Derived read-only fields defined include `memberId` (L2176), `householdId` (L2188), `identityKey` (L2198), `namesakeCount` (L2209), `possibleDuplicate` (L2219), `possibleDuplicateOf` (L2228), `bulkSignupWarning` (L2289), `capacityWarning` (L2299), `deleted` (L2346), `pets` (L2357). `required: [pets]` at L2364-2365. **No `riskFlag` property** — it would be added here to appear on the generated DTO.
- Response functions: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RespondWithOwner.java` (used by GET) and `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` (used by POST) both call `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)` — no per-field logic, so riskFlag would flow automatically once mapped.

## 4. Relevant OfficeFloor YAML endpoints (`src/main/resources/officefloor/`)

- POST pipeline: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — orders the steps: checkIdempotency → build → assignHousehold → ensureUniqueIdentity → assignMemberId → assignNamesakeCount → ensureCityCapacity → ensureDailyOwnerLimit → assignPossibleDuplicate → save → recordIdempotency → audit → notify → respond.
- GET pipeline (what the test reads riskFlag from): `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` — `LoadOwner` → `RespondWithOwner`.
- Also: `{ownerId}.PUT.yml`, `{ownerId}.DELETE.yml`, `owners.GET.yml`.
- Escalation handlers: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/` — `...CityAtCapacityException.yml`, `...DuplicateIdentityException.yml`, `...InvalidEmailException.yml` (map exceptions to handler classes in `src/.../rest/escalation/`).

Since riskFlag is a derived response field (like `capacityWarning`), it most likely needs **only** an `openapi.yml` property + an `OwnerMapper` mapping expression — no new YAML pipeline step required.

## 5. Build / test tooling

- Maven (wrapper `./mvnw`), `pom.xml` at repo root. No Gradle.
- Build: `mvn clean install` (readme L218) — required because `OwnerDto`/`OwnerFieldsDto` and API interfaces are generated by the **openapi-generator-maven-plugin** (`pom.xml` L369-411, generator `spring`, `modelNameSuffix=Dto`, model package `...rest.dto`, output `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` added via build-helper L412-428) and MapStruct processes the mapper.
- Run app: `./mvnw spring-boot:run` (readme L25).
- Tests: JUnit 5 via `spring-boot-starter-test` (pom L140), `spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test` (L145), `spring-boot-starter-security-test` (L150), plus OfficeFloor `woof_test` (L160). Run with `mvn test` / `mvn verify`.
- Acceptance test harness: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser(roles OWNER_ADMIN...)`; black-box via `POST /api/owners` then `GET /api/owners/{id}`. Helpers: `createOwnerOk`, `getOwner`, `structuredOwner()`, `fillCity(city,n)`, `ownerNode()`, plus pinned reference tables (CITY_REGION, REGION_POSTCODES, HOLIDAYS) and `sha256hex`/`luhn` helpers.

## Key guidance docs
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/AGENTS.md` — OfficeFloor endpoint conventions (YAML naming `<path>.<METHOD>.yml`, one function class per step, `next:`/`outputs:`, `govern: [transaction]`, escalation handlers instead of `@ControllerAdvice`, only one `@RequestBody` binding).
- `/home/daniel/sandbox/CLAUDE.md` — points to AGENTS.md; notes DTOs/security/persistence unchanged from Spring, only request handling is OfficeFloor.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
            When supplied it prefixes the derived 'salutation'.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat string for
            backward compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2'
            fields are supplied they take precedence. On the response it is the
            composed, normalized address (normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Stored and returned normalized.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When present it
            is normalized and appended (after a single space) to 'addressLine1' in the
            composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
